options.text: Tell me about the Shot Put area.

steps.player: Tell me about the Shot Put area.

steps.npc: Of course [Madam/Sir]. There are two different weights of shot...
Yes [Madam/Sir]. Shot. The iron spheres that are propelled by the chemical energy stored in your body.
Your strength [Madam/Sir]. The stronger you are, the further you can throw the shot, but there are other factors of course, like your technique.

steps.text: The Referee sighs, rolls his eyes and continues....

steps.npc: [Madam/Sir], the style in which you throw the shot, not the style of the iron.

steps.player: Oh! You mean the spinny round thing or the chuck it straight?

steps.npc: Crudely put [Madam/Sir], but yes. Some are more difficult than others. Experiment and see which you prefer.

options.text: May I claim my tokens please?

steps.player: May I claim my tokens please?

steps.text: If the player is eligible to receive tokens:

steps.npc: Of course! Here you go, you've earned [X] tokens!

steps.text: a number of warrior guild tokens
If the player's inventory is full:

steps.npc: You don't have space to carry them.

steps.text: If the player is not eligible to receive tokens:

steps.player: May I claim my tokens please?

steps.npc: I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.

steps.player: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.

options.text: Do you have any tips for me?

steps.player: Do you have any tips for me?
Yes, like how can I do better than everyone else.

steps.npc: [Madam/Sir] may find that a fine powder applied to the hands may give one an advantage when putting the shot.

steps.player: You mean if I grind something up and put dust on my hands I'll chuck the ball further?

standard-dialogue-when-successfully-thro.speaker: [18lb/22lb] Shot Put Referee
standard-dialogue-when-successfully-thro.text: Well done. You threw the shot [1-14] yards!

standard-dialogue-when-attempting-to-pic.speaker: [18lb/22lb] Shot Put Referee
standard-dialogue-when-attempting-to-pic.text: Hey! You can't take that, it's guild property. Take one from the pile.

overhead-dialogue-when-the-shot-hits-the.npc: Oi! Watch where you're throwing that [player name]!
